HGNC explicitly lists Q5T0F9 as a UniProt ID for CC2D1B, and the many unreviewed human entries with the identical protein name carry gene CC2D1B. The "TNFRSF10B" gene name in the reviewed entry's `genes` block is inconsistent with the entry name (C2D1B_HUMAN), the CC2D1 family assignment, and the function (DRE-binding transcriptional repressor) — it appears to be an erroneous gene assignment. TNFRSF10B actually encodes TRAIL-R2/DR5 (O14763), an unrelated protein.
